fields.description: In 1989 Rajasthan, IPS officer Patnaik raids a palace but fails. After requesting a bribe, he's transferred to Bhoj, where he investigates Dada Bhai, a respected local figure. Suspended after a failed raid, he uncovers hidden truths.

fields.title: Avatar
fields.description: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

fields.description: A cryptic message from James Bond's past sends him on a trail to uncover the existence of a sinister organisation named SPECTRE. With a new threat dawning, Bond learns the terrible truth about the author of all his pain in his mos...

fields.description: Bane, an imposing terrorist, attacks Gotham City and disrupts its eight-year-long period of peace. This forces Bruce Wayne to come out of hiding and don the cape and cowl of Batman again.

fields.title: John Carter
fields.description: A war-weary former army captain is inexplicably transported to Mars and reluctantly becomes embroiled in a conflict of epic proportions.

fields.title: Spider-Man 3
fields.description: A strange black entity from another world bonds with Peter Parker and causes inner turmoil as he contends with new villains, temptations, and revenge.

fields.title: Tangled
fields.description: The magically long-haired Rapunzel has spent her entire life in a tower, but now that a runaway thief has stumbled upon her, she is about to discover the world for the first time, and who she really is.

fields.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
fields.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

fields.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
fields.description: As Harry Potter begins his sixth year at Hogwarts, he discovers an old book marked as "the property of the Half-Blood Prince" and begins to learn more about Lord Voldemort's dark past.

fields.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
fields.description: Batman is manipulated by Lex Luthor to fear Superman. Superman´s existence is meanwhile dividing the world and he is framed for murder during an international crisis. The heroes clash and force the neutral Wonder Woman to reemerge.

fields.title: Superman Returns
fields.description: Superman returns to Earth after spending five years in space examining his homeworld Krypton. But he finds things have changed while he was gone, and he must once again prove himself important to the world.

fields.title: Quantum of Solace
fields.language: English, Spanish, Italian, French, Swiss German, German
fields.description: James Bond tries to stop an organisation from eliminating a country's most valuable resource.

fields.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
fields.description: Jack Sparrow races to recover the heart of Davy Jones to avoid enslaving his soul to Jones' service, as other friends and foes seek the heart for their own agenda as well.

fields.title: The Lone Ranger
fields.description: Native American warrior Tonto recounts the untold tales that transformed John Reid, a man of the law, into a legend of justice.

fields.title: Man of Steel
fields.description: An alien child is evacuated from his dying world and sent to Earth to live among humans. His peace is threatened when other survivors of his home planet invade Earth.

fields.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
fields.description: The Pevensie siblings return to Narnia, where they are enlisted to help ward off an evil king and restore the rightful heir to the land's throne, Prince Caspian.

fields.title: The Avengers
fields.description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

fields.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
fields.description: Jack Sparrow and Barbossa embark on a quest to find the elusive fountain of youth, only to discover that Blackbeard and his daughter are after it too.

fields.description: Bilbo Baggins and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.

fields.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
fields.description: After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

fields.title: Robin Hood
fields.description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of world power.

fields.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
fields.description: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain, their homeland, from the dragon Smaug.

fields.title: The Golden Compass
fields.description: In a parallel universe, young Lyra Belacqua journeys to the far North to save her best friend and other kidnapped children from terrible experiments by a mysterious organization.

fields.title: King Kong
fields.description: A greedy film producer assembles a team of moviemakers and sets out for the infamous Skull Island, where they find more than just cannibalistic natives.

fields.title: Titanic
fields.description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

fields.title: Captain America: Civil War
fields.description: Political involvement in the Avengers' affairs causes a rift between Captain America and Iron Man.

fields.title: Battleship
fields.description: A fleet of ships is forced to do battle with an armada of unknown origins in order to discover and thwart their destructive goals.

fields.title: Jurassic World
fields.description: A new theme park, built on the original site of Jurassic Park, creates a genetically modified hybrid dinosaur, the Indominus Rex, which escapes containment and goes on a killing spree.

fields.title: Skyfall
fields.description: James Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt her. When MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat, no matter how personal the cost.

fields.title: Spider-Man 2
fields.description: Peter Parker is beset with troubles in his failing personal life as he battles a former brilliant scientist named Otto Octavius.

fields.title: Iron Man 3
fields.description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

fields.title: Alice in Wonderland
fields.description: Nineteen-year-old Alice returns to the magical world from her childhood adventure, where she reunites with her old friends and learns of her true destiny: to end the Red Queen's reign of terror.

fields.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
fields.description: The human government develops a cure for mutations, and Jean Grey becomes a darker uncontrollable persona called the Phoenix who allies with Magneto, causing escalation into an all-out battle for the X-Men.

fields.title: Monsters University
fields.description: A look at the relationship between Mike Wazowski and James P. "Sully" Sullivan during their days at Monsters University, when they weren't necessarily the best of friends.

fields.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
fields.description: Sam Witwicky leaves the Autobots behind for a normal life. But when his mind is filled with cryptic symbols, the Decepticons target him and he is dragged back into the Transformers' war.

fields.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
fields.description: When humanity allies with a bounty hunter in pursuit of Optimus Prime, the Autobots turn to a mechanic and his family for help.

fields.title: Oz: The Great and Powerful
fields.description: A small-time magician is swept away to an enchanted land and is forced into a power struggle among three witches.

fields.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
fields.description: When New York is put under siege by Oscorp, it is up to Spider-Man to save the city he swore to protect as well as his loved ones.

fields.title: TRON: Legacy
fields.description: The son of a computer programmer goes looking for his father and ends up inside the digital world that his father designed. He meets his father's corrupted creation and a unique ally who was born inside the digital world.

fields.title: Cars 2
fields.description: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his pal Mater head overseas to compete in the World Grand Prix race. But the road to the championship becomes rocky as Mater gets caught up in an intriguing adventure of his own: international e...

fields.title: Green Lantern
fields.description: Reckless test pilot Hal Jordan is granted an alien ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers that inducts him into an intergalactic police force, the Green Lantern Corps.

fields.title: Toy Story 3
fields.description: The toys are mistakenly delivered to a day-care center instead of the attic right before Andy leaves for college, and it's up to Woody to convince the other toys that they weren't abandoned and to return home.

fields.title: Terminator Salvation
fields.description: As the machines prepare for a final attack, John Connor and a mysterious stranger delve into the heart of Skynet and uncover a terrible secret involving the annihilation of mankind.

fields.title: Furious 7
fields.description: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.

fields.title: World War Z
fields.description: Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane traverses the world in a race against time to stop a zombie pandemic that is toppling armies and governments and threatens to destroy humanity itself.

fields.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
fields.description: The X-Men send Wolverine to the past in a desperate effort to change history and prevent an event that results in doom for both humans and mutants.

fields.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
fields.description: After the crew of the Enterprise find an unstoppable force of terror from within their own organization, Captain Kirk leads a manhunt to a war-zone world to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

fields.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
fields.description: The ancient war between humans and a race of giants is reignited when Jack, a young farmhand fighting for a kingdom and the love of a princess, opens a gateway between the two worlds.

fields.title: The Great Gatsby
fields.description: A writer and wall street trader, Nick Carraway, finds himself drawn to the past and lifestyle of his mysterious millionaire neighbor, Jay Gatsby, amid the riotous parties of the Jazz Age.

fields.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
fields.description: A young fugitive prince and princess must stop a villain who unknowingly threatens to destroy the world with a special dagger that enables the magic sand inside to reverse time.

fields.title: Pacific Rim
fields.description: As a war between humankind and monstrous sea creatures wages on, a former pilot and a trainee are paired up to drive a seemingly obsolete special weapon in a desperate effort to save the world from the apocalypse.

fields.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
fields.description: The Autobots learn of a Cybertronian spacecraft hidden on the moon, and race against the Decepticons to reach it and to learn its secrets.

fields.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
fields.description: In 1957, Indiana Jones is called back into action when he becomes entangled in a Soviet plot to uncover the secret behind mysterious artifacts known as the Crystal Skulls.

fields.title: The Good Dinosaur
fields.description: In a world where dinosaurs and humans live side-by-side, an Apatosaurus named Arlo makes an unlikely human friend.

fields.title: Brave
fields.description: Determined to make her own path in life, Princess Merida defies a custom that brings chaos to her kingdom. Granted one wish, Merida must rely on her bravery and her archery skills to undo a beastly curse.

fields.title: Star Trek Beyond
fields.description: The crew of the USS Enterprise explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a new ruthless enemy, who puts them, and everything the Federation stands for, to the test.

fields.title: WALL·E
fields.description: A robot who is responsible for cleaning a waste-covered Earth meets another robot and falls in love with her. Together, they set out on a journey that will alter the fate of mankind.

fields.title: Rush Hour 3
fields.description: After an attempted assassination on Ambassador Han, Lee and Carter head to Paris to protect a French woman with knowledge of the Triads' secret leaders.

fields.language: English, French, Tibetan, Mandarin, Russian, Hindi, Portuguese, Latin, Italian, Spanish
fields.description: A frustrated writer struggles to keep his family alive when a series of global catastrophes threatens to annihilate mankind.

fields.title: A Christmas Carol
fields.description: Ebenezer Scrooge, a miserly old moneylender, is visited by three Christmas spirits on Christmas Eve. Scrooge embarks on a journey of self-redemption to mend his miserly ways

fields.title: Jupiter Ascending
fields.description: A genetically engineered soldier informs a young woman of her extraordinary destiny.

fields.title: The Legend of Tarzan
fields.description: Tarzan, having acclimated to life in London, is called back to his former home in the jungle to investigate the activities at a mining encampment.

fields.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
fields.description: While playing, Lucy and her siblings find a wardrobe that lands them in a mystical place called Narnia. Here they realize that it was fated and they must now unite with Aslan to defeat an evil queen.

fields.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
fields.description: In the 1980s, the X-Men must defeat an ancient all-powerful mutant, En Sabah Nur, who intends to thrive by bringing destruction to the world.

fields.title: The Dark Knight
fields.description: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.

fields.title: Up
fields.description: 78-year-old Carl Fredricksen travels to South America in his house equipped with balloons, inadvertently taking a young stowaway.

fields.title: Monsters vs Aliens
fields.description: On Halloween, innocent-looking carved pumpkins reveal themselves for what they really are -- mutant aliens.

fields.title: Iron Man
fields.language: English, Persian, Urdu, Arabic, Kurdish, Hindi, Hungarian
fields.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

fields.title: Hugo
fields.description: In 1931 Paris, an orphan living in the walls of a train station gets wrapped up in a mystery involving his late father and an automaton.

fields.title: Wild Wild West
fields.description: The two best special agents in the Wild West must save President Grant from the clutches of a diabolical, wheelchair-bound, steampunk-savvy, Confederate scientist bent on revenge for losing the Civil War.

fields.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
fields.description: In the Far East, Alex O'Connell, the son of famed mummy fighters Rick and Evy O'Connell, unearths the mummy of the first Emperor of Qin -- a shape-shifting entity cursed by a witch centuries ago.

fields.title: Suicide Squad
fields.description: A secret government agency recruits some of the most dangerous incarcerated super-villains to form a defensive task force. Their first mission: save the world from the apocalypse.

fields.title: Evan Almighty
fields.description: God contacts Congressman Evan Baxter and tells him to build an ark in preparation for a great flood.

fields.title: Edge of Tomorrow
fields.description: A man fighting in a war against aliens must relive the same day every time he dies until he can find a way to stop their power source with the help of an elite soldier.

fields.title: Waterworld
fields.description: In a future where the polar ice-caps have melted and Earth is almost entirely submerged, a mutated mariner fights starvation and outlaw "smokers," and reluctantly helps a woman and a young girl try to find dry land.

fields.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
fields.description: An elite military unit comprised of special operatives known as G.I. Joe, operating out of The Pit, takes on an evil organization led by a notorious arms dealer.

fields.title: Inside Out
fields.description: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions, Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness, conflict on how best to navigate a new city, house, and school.

fields.title: The Jungle Book
fields.description: After a threat from the tiger Shere Khan forces him to flee the jungle, a man-cub named Mowgli embarks on a journey of self discovery with the help of panther Bagheera and free-spirited bear Baloo.

fields.title: Iron Man 2
fields.description: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful mad man with ties to his father's legacy.

fields.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
fields.description: In a twist to the fairy tale, the Huntsman ordered to take Snow White into the woods to be killed winds up becoming her protector and mentor in a quest to vanquish the Evil Queen.

fields.title: Maleficent
fields.description: A vengeful fairy is driven to curse an infant princess, only to discover that the child could be the one person who can restore peace to their troubled land.

fields.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
fields.description: The fragile peace between apes and humans is threatened as mistrust and betrayal threaten to plunge both tribes into a war for dominance over the Earth.

fields.title: The Lovers
fields.description: Saddled with a dull husband and a foolish lover, a woman has an affair with a stranger.

fields.title: 47 Ronin
fields.description: A band of samurai sets out to avenge the death and dishonor of their master at the hands of a ruthless shogun.

fields.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
fields.description: As Steve Rogers struggles to embrace his role in the modern world, he teams up with a fellow Avenger and S.H.I.E.L.D agent, Black Widow, to battle a new threat from history: an assassin known as the Winter Soldier.

fields.title: Shrek Forever After
fields.description: Rumpelstiltskin tricks a mid-life crisis burdened Shrek into allowing himself to be erased from existence and cast in a dark alternate timeline where Rumpelstiltskin rules supreme.

fields.title: Tomorrowland
fields.description: Bound by a shared destiny, a teen bursting with scientific curiosity and a former boy-genius inventor embark on a mission to unearth the secrets of a place somewhere in time and space that exists in their collective memory.

fields.title: Big Hero 6
fields.description: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who together team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

fields.title: Wreck-It Ralph
fields.description: Ralph is tired of playing the role of a bad guy and embarks on a journey to become a video game hero. But he accidentally lets loose a deadly enemy that threatens the entire arcade.

fields.title: The Polar Express
fields.description: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

fields.title: Independence Day: Resurgence
fields.description: Two decades after the first Independence Day invasion, Earth is faced with a new extra-Solar threat. But will mankind's new space defenses be enough?

fields.title: How to Train Your Dragon
fields.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

fields.title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
fields.description: John Connor must face a female Terminator with power over all the machines. But a new Terminator unit, a T-850, is sent back through time to help guide him through the coming battle.

fields.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
fields.description: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.

fields.title: Interstellar
fields.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

fields.title: Inception
fields.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

fields.title: Shin Godzilla
fields.description: Something has surfaced in Tokyo Bay. As the Prime Minister of Japan pleads with the public to remain calm, a horrific creature of tremendous size makes landfall in the city, leaving death and destruction in its wake. Then it evolves.

fields.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
fields.description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

fields.title: The Fast and the Furious
fields.description: Los Angeles police officer Brian O'Conner must decide where his loyalty really lies when he becomes enamored with the street racing world he has been sent undercover to end it.
